'''House Araba''' was a [[Noble/Legends|noble]] house that settled in the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]]. The [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Cyimarra]] served as their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. House Araba also controlled [[Mussubir Three|Mussubir]], [[Presteen]], [[Skärtis]] and [[Veron/Legends|Veron]].
